about_title: The shears for the sheet-metal shop — hydraulic and electric, 16 ga to 1/4″
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification, inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with the same CSA-approved panel, 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, as every machine we sell.

These are the shears for HVAC, ductwork, signage, enclosures, roofing and the general repair shop, where a 10 ft × 1/4″ plate shear is more machine than the work needs: the HQ01 light hydraulic shears for 14 ga over 52″ and 16 ga over 98″; the THS and HQ11 hydraulic shears from 12 ga to 1/4″ over 51″ to 120″ with front and back gauges, quick-set blade clearance and an electric or NC back gauge; and the Q11 electric shears, 14 ga to 5/32″ over 49″ to 100″, with a manual back gauge and counter or a PLC with motorised back gauge. Every machine ships with front and back gauges, a foot pedal and two-edged blades.
